name: Yoma Yangon International Marathon
short_description: The Yoma Yangon International Marathon is a half marathon, 10 km and 5 km event in Yangon, Myanmar; the 2026 edition started and finished at Thuwunna National Indoor Stadium (1).
ai_summary: The Yoma Yangon International Marathon is organised by Yoma in Yangon, Myanmar. Despite the name, the ninth edition on 22 February 2026 had no full marathon: it offered a 21 km half marathon, a 10 km challenge run and a 5 km fun run, starting and finishing at Thuwunna National Indoor Stadium (1) on Waizayanta Road. The organiser's site looks ahead to a 2027 edition but had not published its date when checked on 29 September 2026.

core_facts.venue: Thuwunna National Indoor Stadium (1), Waizayanta Road, Thingangyun Township (2026 start and finish)

pros: Half-marathon loop through central Yangon, from the Strand to Shwedagon Pagoda Road
Generous cut-offs: 4 hours for the half marathon, 2 hours for the 10 km
Prize money ten deep for men and women in the half and 10 km
Overseas runners could collect race packs on race morning in 2026
cons: No full marathon in 2026 despite the name
25°C and 89% humidity at the 5am start in 2026
Runners may not carry their own drinks, and there is no bag storage
Visa needed in advance, cash-based travel, and a volatile security situation in Myanmar

faqs.question: When is the Yoma Yangon International Marathon?
faqs.answer: The 2027 date had not been published on the organiser's site when checked on 29 September 2026; its Yangon page only looks ahead to a 2027 edition. The previous edition, the ninth, was held on Sunday 22 February 2026, the first since January 2020, with the half marathon starting at 5am.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at this race?
faqs.answer: Three: a 21 km half marathon, a 10 km challenge run and a 5 km fun run. There was no full marathon in 2026 despite the event's name, although earlier editions included 42 km. Cut-offs in 2026 were four hours for the half marathon, two hours for the 10 km and 90 minutes for the 5 km.

faqs.question: Where does the race take place?
faqs.answer: In Yangon, Myanmar. In 2026 all three races started and finished at Thuwunna National Indoor Stadium (1) on Waizayanta Road in Thingangyun Township, and the half-marathon loop ran through central Yangon via the Strand and Shwedagon Pagoda Road. The 2027 venue had not been confirmed when checked.
